notes: וְגַם → 'Moreover' fused under rule 30, headed on גַּם as the content morpheme; the competing reading gives the word to the waw and leaves גַּם unrepresented.

רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת → 'the heads of the fathers houses': arthrous rectum count (rule 29) gives the second the to the article, the supplied 'houses' completes elliptical אָבוֹת (rule 31); bare accusative יְרוּשָׁלִַם takes its supplied to (rule 33).
